feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Democrats demand Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of midterms
entry.summary: The lawmakers wrote that they share "grave concern that time is running out … to assist state and local election officials in protecting our elections from cyber and mis-and disinformation threats."

entry.title: Inside the failed mission to eliminate FEMA
entry.summary: David Richardson worked to eliminate the country's top disaster agency when he led FEMA last year. Now, he says the administration has abandoned that goal.

entry.title: Veteran political journalist on division among Democrats over Democratic Socialism
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with CNN senior political analyst Ron Brownstein about the Democratic Party's division over embracing Democratic Socialism.

entry.title: Ex-National Security Council director on administration's plan for Venezuela oil
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks former Obama administration official Benjamin Gedan {guh-DAN} about the viability of the Trump administration's plan for Venezuelan oil.

entry.title: How will tariffs affect the midterms? In this Michigan border town, it's complicated
entry.summary: The recent trade war between the U.S. and Canada has both economic and political implications for Michigan, given it's the state's top trade partner.

entry.title: Whistleblower's lawyer warns USPS plan for Trump's order could keep ballots from voters
entry.summary: A lawyer for an anonymous whistleblower says Postal Service plans for an unusual verification rule, combined with a hastily built online system, could delay mail ballots from reaching eligible voters.

entry.title: Trump attempts to combat high gas prices as affordability crisis looms over midterms
entry.summary: President Trump seems to be pulling out all the stops to mitigate high gas prices ahead of the midterms.

entry.title: Political consultant on how the cost-of-living is affecting Trump's approval rating
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political consultant Sarah Longwell about Trump's low approval rating and high gas prices, as affordability shadows the approaching midterm election.

entry.title: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary for U.S. Senate
entry.summary: Bucking a push for younger leadership this election season, Sen. Ed Markey, 80, won the Democratic nomination against Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who said that his party needed new leaders.

entry.title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
entry.summary: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members.
